# Clean the cliff sensors

[All care guides](README.md)

## Roomba 600 and 700 series · Roomba 800 and 900 series

![Clean the cliff sensors](../img/underside_600_900--cliff_sensors.svg)

**What it does**

The cliff sensors look down for stairs and drops. Dust on their windows can stop the robot or let it miss an edge.

**How to**

1. Turn the robot over.
2. Wipe each sensor window with a slightly damp melamine sponge or cloth.
3. Check that no window is scratched or covered.

> **Note** Never spray a cleaning agent onto the sensors or into their openings.
